page.overview:
Who is Bruhathkayosaurus?

(meaning "huge-bodied lizard") is an extinct genus of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/sauropod sauropod] dinosaur that lived in India during the Late Cretaceous period. This giant dinosaur with a really long name could be the biggest dinosaur ever discovered. For several years it was thought to be a gigantic meat-eater, but it was recently classified as a sauropod, the long-necked family of dinosaurs that includes Argentinosaurus. Bruhathkayosaurus was among the largest dinosaurs that ever lived and would have been an awesome sight to see. It was about twice as big as a Tyrannosaurus rex.

Some scientists don't think that the Bruhathkayosaurus fossils clearly illustrate the dinosaur's size. These scientists believe the actual size may have been somewhat smaller, but still very impressive.

Bruhathkayosaurus was featured in the Jurassic Park Institute now available to browse on Dinopedia.
